policy_extraction.issuing_body: Presidential Committee on the Digital Platform Government / National Information Society Agency
covered_actors: Central ministries, local governments, public institutions, National Assembly, and courts (전 공공부문) and public-sector IT system administrators
Private cloud computing service providers (CSAP-certified IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS providers)
Private hyperscale AI, LLM, and sLLM developers, SI firms, startups, and vendors supplying AI services to the public sector via the Digital Service Support System or public procurement tenders

policy_extraction.implementation_notes: First edition (April 2024) of South Korea's public-sector hyperscale AI adoption guideline issued jointly by the Presidential Committee on the Digital Platform Government and NIA, subsequently superseded by Version 2.0 (April 2025). Covers domestic LLM landscape (Kakao, KT, LG, Naver, SKT), six public-service use-case categories, five Digital Platform Government adoption principles (private cloud first, agile workflow redesign, cross-ministry integration, national security & citizens' rights, MSIT 2020 AI Ethics Principles), step-by-step cloud/model/training-method selection (foundation, fine-tuning, post-training, RAG), Digital Service Specialized Contract procurement vs. competitive tenders, a 17-item vendor Service Level Objective (SLO) catalog, a four-unit internal governance model (planning, AI tech, AI ethics, infosec), a 6-part adoption checklist, and 10 2023 public-sector PoC pilots. Notably leaves Section 3.2.1 (Data Security Classification) as a placeholder pending inter-agency government network security policy finalization (later filled in Version 2.0 with C/S/O tiers).

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The 2024 Public-Sector Hyperscale AI Guideline is overwhelmingly framed around innovation_enablement: grounded in the Digital Platform Government initiative, it promotes rapid, agile public-sector adoption of commercial private-cloud hyperscale AI, streamlined Digital Service purchasing, cross-ministry data/resource sharing, and administrative workflow automation to eliminate citizen inconvenience and solve social problems. Innovation_enablement strongly outpaces economic_competitiveness because the text centers on modernizing government service delivery and operational adoption mechanics, while economic_competitiveness is the clearest secondary frame via explicit goals to foster the domestic AI industry ecosystem, give Korean enterprises growth opportunities, and advance Korea's hyperscale AI competitiveness plan. Fundamental_rights (privacy, copyright, AI ethics, non-bias), consumer_public_safety (mitigating hallucination/error and supporting rail/disaster safety), and national_security (preventing external leakage of classified/sensitive government data) serve as key operational guardrails.

evidence_spans.quote: - 디지털플랫폼정부(Digital Platform Government)는 인공지능, 데이터 중심의 디지털 심화 시대 도래에 따라 디지털 기술과 민간의 혁신 역량을 최대한 수용하여 국민의 불편을 없애고, 국민 중심으로 정부가 한 팀으로 뛰는 정부혁신, 기업에게 성장의 기회를 제공하는 것 등을 목표로 하고 있음
evidence_spans.quote_en: The Digital Platform Government aims to embrace digital technology and private-sector innovation capacity to eliminate citizen inconvenience, drive citizen-centered one-team government innovation, and provide growth opportunities for enterprises.

evidence_spans.quote: - 이러한 초거대 AI의 혁신 기술을 활용하여 복지, 재난, 청년 등 사회현안의 해결에 기여 하고, 공공의 본질적 업무나 반드시 사람의 참여･검토 등을 필요로 하는 창의적 업무에 보다 많은 시간을 할애할 수 있도록 함
evidence_spans.quote_en: Leverages innovative hyperscale AI technologies to help solve social issues such as welfare, disasters, and youth challenges while freeing time for essential public duties and creative work requiring human participation and review.

evidence_spans.quote: - (과기정통부) 초거대 AI의 가능성에 대비하고 디지털 모범국가로서의 기틀을 마련하기 위하여 ‘초거대 AI 경쟁력 강화 방안’(’23.4월)을 통해 다음과 같은 추진전략을 수립함
evidence_spans.quote_en: MSIT established its 'Hyperscale AI Competitiveness Enhancement Plan' (April 2023) to prepare for hyperscale AI's potential and lay foundations as a model digital nation.

evidence_spans.quote:
원칙4 국가 안보와 국민 권리 보호를 보장
- 민감, 기밀 데이터의 외부 유출 방지

evidence_spans.quote_en: Principle 4: Guarantee national security and protection of citizens' rights—prevent external leakage of sensitive/classified data and protect personal information and copyright in training data.

evidence_spans.quote_en: Externally, governance organizations are also necessary to respond to social and ethical risks—including bias, hallucination, and misuse—arising from hyperscale AI utilization.
